rule: Evals fills only from a stored first-party URL that is clearly a published evaluation of the company's AI system: a model card or system card with eval tables, an official eval report, or a first-party safety evals page. A generic research blog or marketing benchmarks page is not enough. No SafeBase, login walls, third-party leaderboards, or invented URLs. When unsure, leave open. Anthropic stays open unless a real stored first-party instrument already exists.
method: Conservative fetch-check of stored AITI pages that look like system/model cards, plus first-party URLs actually found on the companies' own hosts. A page fills only when HTTP 200 and the document is a model/system card with eval tables, an official eval report, or a first-party safety-evals page. JS shells, prompt-format docs, RAI service cards, research tech-report landings, product catalogs, and model cards without eval tables stay open. Hypothesis that stored AITI pages would newly fill evals is mostly discarded: DeepSeek and Cohere stored model-card pages do not show eval tables to this crawler.
